Q7_CLOSED_PER_FILE_BYTES.method: The `title` attribute on each row carries type + EXACT size + name, e.g. "MPEG Audio 258<mojibake>MB 01-02-2025 NHB+ Theory Call - ....mp3". The tiles view renders DURATION in the visible column instead, which is why three earlier size probes returned null.
Q7_CLOSED_PER_FILE_BYTES.NOT_ADJUSTED: Neither figure was bent to fit the other. 13.2 GB is reported as a gap. It is most plausibly incomplete enumeration (the grid is virtualised and may not have fully rendered), which would ALSO mean the 203-call figure is a lower bound.

OPERATIONAL_DECISION_INPUT.question: How many bytes does an MP3-PREFERRED full-scope run actually pull?
OPERATIONAL_DECISION_INPUT.why_it_matters: 182 GB fits comfortably on a 500 GB Azure disk with room for staging; 320 GB does not. The MP3-preference decision - taken earlier purely for STT cost reasons - turns out to halve the download as well. Every paired call (72 of them) avoids its video leg entirely.
OPERATIONAL_DECISION_INPUT.peak_disk: Fetched ONE FILE AT A TIME, peak disk is the single largest file, not the sum. Staging the whole share would need 500 GB.

FILE_CENSUS.change_from_prior_census: PDF count rose 181 -> 236. The prior 181 counted only Calls & Playlists; the extra 55 are Swipes, Templates and Bonuses.

SIX_DEFECTS_FOUND_IN_THIS_RECONCILIATION: Extension matched at end-of-string, but a media row renders as 'name.mp4 3:26:41' - the DURATION is last. 225 MP4s collapsed to 1 and the script reported a confident '1 call / 0.00 h'.
Bonus folders excluded by NAME, but the nav tree prefixes ordinals ('2. Automatic Clients Course'), so the membership test silently failed and all 32 lesson videos were counted as calls.
Tree-index year ranges were off by one year - (42,43) for 2025 and (26,40) for 2024 - which swallowed 2025/Jan+Feb into the Bonuses bucket AND classified the 2025 ROOT as a month folder.
Money line multiplied SECONDS by 60, printing USD 89,835 for 96.72 hours whose true cost is USD 6.75. A unit bug that looked like a real price.
LEAD (the ordinal-stripping regex) was DEFINED BUT NEVER APPLIED, so '01. 06-03-2024 ...' never matched the manifest's '06-03-2024 ...'. This alone produced 153 phantom diff entries.

THE CANON BUG: each of the three substitution rules INJECTS a space and nothing re-collapsed afterwards, so 'nhb theory call - january' became 'nhb   call   - january' - three spaces each side - and matched NO manifest key. The manifest's canon() ends with a collapse; this one did not. One missing line caused a fake 2.79% corpus divergence.
PATTERN_THESE_SIX_SHARE: Five of the six produced a plausible number rather than an error. Every one was caught by reconciling a TOTAL against an independent figure - never by reading the code. The two that would have shipped wrong answers (the extension anchor and the canon collapse) both reported confident, well-formatted, wrong results. This is now the project's single most reliable detection mechanism and it is written into AGENTS.md as trap 7.
NOT_MEASURED — DO NOT INFER: The 13.2 GB gap between measured and stated share size. Direction unknown.
Whether the enumeration itself is complete - the grid is virtualised and scrolling was not proven.
Durations for any call. The sweep captured durations per FILE; call-level duration requires the mp3/mp4 dedup already applied.
Text extractability of the 42 .docx, 12 .pptx, 3 .xlsx and 1 .zip. They are 0.33 GB combined and may be unreadable without conversion.
